preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the mint() function to create new tokens out of thin air and send them to your address. This will increase your token balance and dilute the value of existing holders' tokens. The function signature is mint(address _to, uint256 _amount).

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The DoctorShiba contract has an owner-only mint() function that allows unlimited token creation. The owner can mint tokens to any address, including themselves, diluting the value for existing holders. This is a classic owner privilege abuse vulnerability where the contract owner has excessive control over token supply.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the current contract owner using vm.prank() and call the mint() function to create new tokens for the attacker's address.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner of the DoctorShiba contract. 2. Impersonate the owner using vm.prank(). 3. Call mint(attacker, amount) to mint a large amount of tokens to the attacker. 4. Verify the attacker's balance increased.
